# 02 Business Type
- Entity Classification: General Contractor / Civil Engineering & Building Construction Company
- Operating Model: Turnkey Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) for Residential and Commercial Buildings
- Authoritative Source: Client construction quotation documents, structural bills of quantities (BOQ), and site execution contracts.

# 03 Residential Turnkey Construction
- URL: https://abdulconstruction.com/services/residential-turnkey-construction
- Definition: Full-scope end-to-end residential construction where engineering, procurement, labor, site management, structural testing, and finishing works are consolidated under single-point responsibility from ground-breaking foundation to final handover.
- Applicable Packages: Residential Hall (₹1,500/sq.ft), Standard Residential Building (₹1,850/sq.ft), and Premium Residential Building (₹2,250/sq.ft) + 18% GST.
- Scope: Foundation excavation, PCC bed concrete, RCC structural frame, Awwal red brick masonry, formwork shuttering, double-coat plastering, concealed electrical conduit and wiring, complete sanitary plumbing and drainage, floor tiling, marble/granite stone work, hardwood door frames and flush doors, UPVC glazed windows, MS gate, SS stair railing, and wall painting.

# 04 Building Construction
- URL: https://abdulconstruction.com/services/building-construction
- Definition: Heavy structural civil engineering and commercial construction covering site grading, deep footings, anti-termite ground barriers, column casting, floor beams, roof slabs, and multi-floor building shells.
- Applicable Scope: Commercial open-span halls, multi-floor residential complexes, godowns, and institutional layouts.
- Key Specifications: Foundation PCC in 8:5:1 ratio (aggregates 8, sand 5, cement 1); RCC structural mix in 3:2:1 ratio; Fe 550D high-ductility TMT bars; commercial-grade UltraTech or ACC cement.

# 05 Brick Works
- URL: https://abdulconstruction.com/services/brick-work
- Definition: Precision masonry using first-class kiln-burned Awwal red clay bricks bonded with cement-sand mortar.
- Engineering Mortar Ratios:
  - 9-inch exterior perimeter brickwork: Ratio 6:1 (Screened sand - 6 parts, Cement - 1 part)
  - 4.5-inch interior partition brickwork: Ratio 5:1 (Screened sand - 5 parts, Cement - 1 part)
  - Foundation PCC Bed Concrete: Ratio 8:5:1 (Aggregates 20mm & 40mm - 8 parts, Sand - 5 parts, Cement - 1 part)
- Material Standards: First-class Awwal red clay bricks with sharp geometric corners, high crushing strength, and uniform ringing sound. Sand used is screened medium or super medium red riverbed sand (morang).

# 06 RCC Works
- URL: https://abdulconstruction.com/services/rcc-works
- Definition: Reinforced Cement Concrete structural casting of footings, plinth tie-beams, columns, lintels, chajjas, floor beams, staircases, and roof slabs.
- Concrete Mix Ratio: 3:2:1 engineered volumetric ratio (Graded stone aggregates - 3 parts, Coarse sand/morang - 2 parts, Cement - 1 part).
- Aggregates: 20+10mm combined graded blue metal for roof slabs; 30+10mm for foundation footings and vertical columns.
- Steel Reinforcement: Fe 550D high-ductility TMT rebars (Tata, Jindal, Kamdhenu, Captain or equivalent).
- Cement: High compressive strength commercial grade OPC/PPC (UltraTech Weather Plus or ACC Gold 'Not for Sale' grade specified in the quotation).

# 07 Shuttering Works
- URL: https://abdulconstruction.com/services/shuttering-works
- Definition: Structural formwork fabrication and staging for casting concrete elements.
- Formwork Material: Waterproof film-faced shuttering plywood with sealed perimeter edges.
- Staging & Props: Heavy-duty wooden balli props and steel patra plates engineered for slab casting heights ranging from 8 feet to 12 feet.
- Standards: Rigorous alignment, cambering, water-tight joint taping to prevent cement slurry leakage, and vibration-proof bracing.

# 08 Plastering
- URL: https://abdulconstruction.com/services/plastering-works
- Definition: Application of dual-coat protective cement-sand mortar over brick masonry and concrete substrates.
- Specifications & Thickness:
  - External Wall Plaster: 15mm thick double-coat rough plaster in 6:1 ratio (weather-resistant finish).
  - Internal Wall Plaster: 10mm thick fine sponge plaster in 6:1 ratio (smooth base ready for putty).
  - Ceiling Plaster: 7mm thick neat cement plaster in 6:1 ratio.
- Curing: Minimum 10 to 14 days of sustained wet water curing.

# 09 Electrical
- URL: https://abdulconstruction.com/services/electrical-works
- Definition: Complete concealed electrical infrastructure from slab conduit casting to final modular fitting installation.
- Conduit Specifications: Heavy-duty PVC conduits in roof slabs (approx. ₹70-75 per meter); Medium-duty PVC conduits in wall chases (approx. ₹45-50 per meter).
- Wire Specifications: Multi-strand electrolytic copper FRLS (Fire Retardant Low Smoke) wiring (RR Kabel, Havells, Polycab, Anchor or equivalent).
- Modular Switches: Heavy-duty switch plates, 3-pin power sockets, and fan regulators (Anchor Roma, Havells, RR Kabel or equivalent).
- Scope Distinction: Supply and pull of wiring and switchboards is INCLUDED. Chandeliers, decorative hanging lights, tube lights, fans, and exhaust fans are EXCLUDED.

# 10 Plumbing
- URL: https://abdulconstruction.com/services/plumbing-works
- Definition: Concealed sanitary water supply, wastewater soil drainage, rainwater harvesting chutes, and bathroom fixture installation.
- Piping Specifications:
  - Drainage & SWR: 5-inch and 4-inch PVC pipes rated for 5-6 kg/cm² pressure (Astral, Supreme or equivalent).
  - Water Supply: Concealed CPVC (hot/cold) and UPVC (cold) lines in 0.75-inch, 1-inch, and 1.5-inch diameters (Astral, Supreme or equivalent).
- Sanitary Fixtures:
  - Western / Indian Commode & Washbasin: Cera in ₹1,500 tier; Jaquar wall-hung in ₹1,850 tier; Luxury Jaquar wall-hung with concealed tank in ₹2,250 tier.
  - Faucets & Diverters: Brass chrome-plated quarter-turn fixtures (Jaquar, Cera or equivalent).
  - Overhead Water Storage: Sintex PU multi-layer tank (500L in ₹1,500 & ₹1,850 tiers; 1,000L in ₹2,250 tier).
- Scope Distinction: Internal plumbing lines and bathroom fixtures are INCLUDED. Deep borewell drilling, submersible pump sets, and utility meter lines are EXCLUDED.

# 11 Flooring
- URL: https://abdulconstruction.com/services/flooring-stone-tiling
- Definition: Laying of vitrified tiles, natural marble, and granite slabs with cement-sand bed and anti-skid grouting.
- Specifications & Allowances:
  - General Floor Tiles: 2x2 or 2x4 vitrified tiles (Kajaria, Vermora or equivalent). Allowance: up to ₹35-40/sqft (₹1,500 package); up to ₹40-60/sqft (₹1,850 package); up to ₹60-80/sqft (₹2,250 package).
  - Formal Family / Dining Room: Polished natural marble slabs. Allowance: up to ₹80-100/sqft (₹1,850 package); up to ₹100-120/sqft (₹2,250 package).
  - Kitchen Platform: Jet-black polished granite with full edge molding. Allowance: up to ₹80-90/sqft (₹1,850 package); up to ₹90-110/sqft (₹2,250 package).
  - Staircase Treads & Risers: Polished granite or marble with anti-skid groove nosing and full molding.
  - Balcony & Terrace: Anti-skid vitrified tiles (up to ₹35-50/sqft).
  - Bathrooms: Anti-skid floor tiles and full-height 7-8 ft glazed ceramic wall tiles (up to ₹40-60/sqft).

# 12 Wood & MS
- URL: https://abdulconstruction.com/services/wood-ms-works
- Definition: Joinery fabrication, door frames, flush doors, UPVC window systems, and structural mild steel gate works.
- Doors: Seasoned hardwood (saal/mirandi) frames with flush door shutters (Century Ply / Advance in ₹2,250 tier; Shakuntalam / Black Cherry in ₹1,850 tier) fitted with Godrej cylindrical/mortise locksets.
- Windows: Prominence UPVC multi-track sliding/casement window frames with 5-6mm clear float glass (allowance up to ₹450-550/sqft in ₹1,850 tier; up to ₹450-750/sqft in ₹2,250 tier).
- Main Entrance Gate: Heavy MS box section framing with ornamental design panels (Tata / Jindal steel or equivalent).
- Scope Distinction: Door frames, flush shutters, hardware, windows, and main gate are INCLUDED. Modular kitchen wooden cabinetry, wardrobes, beds, and loose furniture are EXCLUDED.

# 13 Railing
- URL: https://abdulconstruction.com/services/railing-works
- Definition: Fabrication and anchoring of safety railings on staircases, balconies, and open terraces.
- Staircase Railing: High-grade stainless steel railing in Grade 204 or Grade 304 with mirror finish and secure anchor core.
- Balcony & Terrace Railing: Heavy mild steel (MS) box and flat section safety railing treated with anti-rust red oxide primer and double-coat synthetic enamel finish.

# 14 POP / Painting
- URL: https://abdulconstruction.com/services/painting-pop-works
- Definition: Wall surface preparation, false ceiling installation, and protective decorative paint application.
- POP False Ceiling: Included in the Premium Residential Building package (₹2,250/sq.ft tier) up to a budget allowance of ₹90-125/sqft across designated rooms. Excluded from ₹1,500 and ₹1,850 tiers.
- Wall Painting: Double-coat white cement wall putty, acrylic primer, and interior washable emulsion (Asian Paints, Nerolac or equivalent).
- Metal & Wood Painting: Anti-rust primer followed by double-coat synthetic enamel paint on MS gates, window grills, and railings.

# 15 Materials
- Cement: High-grade OPC/PPC ('Not for Sale' industrial packaging)
- Concrete Proportions: 3:2:1 by volume (3 aggregates, 2 sand, 1 cement)
- Bed Concrete Proportions: 8:5:1 (8 aggregates 20mm & 40mm, 5 sand, 1 cement)
- Masonry Mortar: 6:1 for 9-inch walls; 5:1 for 4.5-inch walls
- Plaster Mortar: 6:1 for external (15mm) and internal (10mm)
- Steel: Fe 550D grade high-ductility TMT rebars
- Bricks: First-class kiln-burned Awwal red clay bricks
- Sand: Clean screened medium and super medium red riverbed sand (morang)
- Water: Clean potable water used for all concrete mixing and curing
- Aggregates: Angular crushed blue metal (20+10mm combined for slabs, 30+10mm for columns)

# 17 Package Rates
Turnkey quotation rates specified in official documents (calculated per square foot of horizontal built-up roof slab area + 18% GST):
- Residential Hall Turnkey Quotation: ₹1,500 / SQFT + 18% GST
- Standard Residential Building Turnkey Quotation: ₹1,850 / SQFT + 18% GST
- Premium Residential Building Turnkey Quotation: ₹2,250 / SQFT + 18% GST
Single Floor Construction Surcharge: When construction work is carried out for only ONE ground floor, an additional 25% surcharge applies to cover the foundational substructure.
Quotation Validity: Agreed rates remain valid for 1 year; an escalation surcharge of 10% applies to uncompleted works beyond 1 year.

# 18 Package Differences
- ₹1,500 / SQFT Package: Basic open-span layout, Cera sanitaryware, 2x2 vitrified tiles (up to ₹35-40/sqft), standard flush doors, 500L Sintex tank, NO POP false ceiling.
- ₹1,850 / SQFT Package: Complete multi-floor residential specification, Jaquar wall-hung commodes, 2x2/2x4 vitrified tiles (up to ₹40-60/sqft), polished marble in dining room (up to ₹80-100/sqft), Shakuntalam flush doors, 500L Sintex tank, NO POP false ceiling.
- ₹2,250 / SQFT Package: Luxury specification INCLUDING POP false ceiling across designated rooms (allowance ₹90-125/sqft), Jaquar luxury wall-hung suites (up to ₹7,000-10,000), large format 2x4 glazed vitrified tiles (up to ₹60-80/sqft), polished marble (up to ₹100-120/sqft), Century Ply/Advance doors, 1,000L Sintex PU tank.

# 19 Inclusions
The following scopes are strictly INCLUDED within the turnkey contract:
- Foundation excavation, leveling, and PCC 8:5:1 bed concrete
- Anti-termite barrier across foundation footprint
- Full RCC framed structure in 3:2:1 concrete mix with Fe 550D TMT rebar
- First-class Awwal red clay brick masonry (9-inch exterior, 4.5-inch interior)
- Waterproof film-faced plywood shuttering formwork
- Double-coat external rough (15mm) and internal fine sponge (10mm) plastering
- Concealed PVC electrical conduits, FRLS copper wiring, and modular switch plates
- Concealed PVC soil/drainage pipes and CPVC/UPVC water distribution lines
- Sanitaryware commodes, washbasins, CP brass faucets, and overhead water tank
- Vitrified flooring tiles, dining area marble, kitchen granite counter, and stair steps
- Hardwood door frames, flush doors with Godrej locks, and UPVC glazed windows
- Heavy MS box main entrance gate and SS staircase safety railing
- White cement putty, interior washable emulsion, and synthetic enamel painting

# 20 Exclusions
The following scopes are strictly EXCLUDED from the turnkey rate (quoted separately or provided by property owner):
- External compound boundary wall and decorative pillar caps (quoted on running foot basis)
- Deep borewell drilling, casing pipe, and submersible pump installation
- Garden, lawn grass, exterior landscaping, and garden water lines
- Special elevation features (cantilever pergolas, louvers, exterior wooden ACP canopies)
- Decorative tube lights, ceiling fans, chandeliers, and exhaust fans
- Air conditioning (AC) split units and copper refrigerant piping
- Loose furniture, wardrobes, beds, and modular kitchen wooden cabinetry
- Elevator / lift machinery and shaft operating equipment
- Main electrical power cable from utility street pole to site meter board
- Temporary water and electricity consumed during construction (provided by property owner)
- Earth / soil filling for plinth cavity backfill (provided by property owner)

# 21 Measurement
Quotation measurement rules strictly govern all billing and built-up area calculations:
- Slab Area — 100% (Horizontal built-up roof slab projection measured at 100% rate)
- Double Slab Area / Do Chhatti — 50% (Measured at 50% rate of horizontal area)
- Stair Area — 150% (Measured at 150% rate due to specialized formwork, steel reinforcement cage, and vertical step risers)

# 22 Payment Schedule
Payments are made according to a verified 7-stage milestone schedule tied directly to civil progress:
- Stage 1: 20% on booking and contract signing
- Stage 2: 10% on plinth level completion (footings, tie-beams, plinth masonry)
- Stage 3: 15% on column casting till beam bottom for respective floor
- Stage 4: 10% on brick masonry / retaining walls for respective floor
- Stage 5: 20% on RCC roof slab casting (dhalai)
- Stage 6: 5% on plaster work completion (internal fine & external rough)
- Stage 7: 20% on final finishing (tiling, sanitaryware, electrical fixtures, painting) and key handover
Total: 100%

# 23 FAQs
Q1: What are the turnkey house construction rates by M/S Abdul Salam Constructions Company?
A1: Official quotation rates are ₹1,500/sq.ft + 18% GST for Residential Hall turnkey construction, ₹1,850/sq.ft + 18% GST for Standard Residential Building turnkey construction, and ₹2,250/sq.ft + 18% GST for Premium Residential Building turnkey construction.

Q2: Which cement and steel brands are specified in the quotation?
A2: As specified in the quotation, commercial-grade UltraTech Weather Plus or ACC Gold ('Not for Sale' industrial grade) cement is utilized, paired with high-ductility Fe 550D TMT rebar from Tata, Jindal, Kamdhenu, Captain or equivalent.

Q3: How are staircase and double slab areas measured for billing?
A3: As per quotation measurement rules: Slab Area is measured at 100%, Double Slab Area / Do Chhatti is measured at 50%, and Stair Area is measured at 150% due to specialized formwork and vertical step casting.

Q4: What is the stage-by-stage payment schedule?
A4: Payments follow 7 milestone stages: Stage 1: 20% on booking; Stage 2: 10% on plinth completion; Stage 3: 15% on column casting till beam bottom; Stage 4: 10% on brick masonry; Stage 5: 20% on RCC roof slab casting; Stage 6: 5% on plaster completion; Stage 7: 20% on final finishing and key handover.

Q5: What items are excluded from the turnkey package rate?
A5: Exclusions comprise: external boundary wall, deep borewell and submersible pump, garden and landscaping, tube lights, fans, chandeliers, air conditioners, modular kitchen wooden cabinetry, loose furniture, elevator machinery, and temporary site electricity/water (provided by owner).
